test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The loft is __fill in__ hay for the winter.
solution:
The correct answer is **"filled with."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice.
 
• So, the verb** 'fill'** needs to be in the past participle form to match the past tense of the sentence.
 
• The correct form of the past participle of** 'fill' **is **'filled'.**
